_provenance: cycle 85 CP: plexscratch42 (PMS 1.42.2.10156), two throwaway TV libraries (C85cpThrowaway, C85cpThrowaway2) created over the reference's Firefly folder and deleted with DELETE /library/sections/{id} while their episodes were queued beside movies of the Movies library; then a control queue of four movies read with window/center (steps *-F). Steps *-F43 repeat the control on plexscratch (PMS 1.43.4.10903). Queues were created with distinct X-Plex-Client-Identifier values (client). Token never logged; machine identifiers and section uuids redacted. Exchanges in order; the first library's immediate reads were not captured (read-late is ~1 min after the delete), the second library's reads (read0*) were sent right after it.

Metadata.title: Cosmos Laundromat
Metadata.summary: On a desolate island, a suicidal sheep named Franck meets his fate…in the form of a quirky salesman named Victor, who offers him the gift of a lifetime. The gift is many lifetimes, actually, in many different worlds – each lasting just a few minutes. In the sequel to the pilot, Franck will find a new reason to live…in the form of a bewitching female adventurer named Tara, who awakens his long-lost lust for life. But can Franck keep up with her?

Metadata.title: Sintel
Metadata.summary: A wandering warrior finds an unlikely friend in the form of a young dragon. The two develop a close bond, until one day the dragon is snatched away. She then sets out on a relentless quest to reclaim her friend, finding in the end that her quest exacts a far greater price than she had ever imagined.
